text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえーい！　
大勝利ー！　
ぶいぶいっ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: That was some good teamwork, Hiyori!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったね、
ヒヨリちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: You'll have to save your celebrations for later.

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
How co— Wait, whaaaaaat?!
Another one appeared!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どういうこと……
ってえええっ！？
また新しいのが出てきたー！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Does that mean they'll keep respawning?
text_block_list.orig_text: 倒してもすぐに別のが出てくるんだね……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Then we just need to keep going until they stop appearing!
Back at it, you two!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だったら出なくなるまで倒し続けるまでだ！
いくよ、
二人とも！
